text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
I've posted the answer in #inc-vtg-hartford.

Your first report was 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: "gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant", with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. The only guard activity recorded in the channel is in that same message: the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo noted the guard checked in trailer 8836. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

The Hartford kiosks ticket SUP-5380 on your team's share has an earlier entry at 08:12 that says "Rebot failed; drivers queueing". That predates your 10:42 report, so the postmortem timeline may need to account for it. The ticket doesn't say what the guard was doing at that time.
